de.description: LA channel (or wiring name) wired to an RS-485 transceiver's DE + /RE. The pod drives it high while it sends and low otherwise, so the transceiver listens whenever the pod is not sending and a fast device's reply is heard. Needs gateware v58. Omit for a plain UART.

half_duplex.description: One-wire UART: rx alone carries both directions (tx defaults to rx). The pod only pulls the line low and its pull-up (LA1-LA6) or the board's holds it high; the pod does not read back its own bytes. For boot-ROM programming pins such as RL78 TOOL0. Needs gateware v57.
